entities.summary: Augustin Simmel Ndiaye is a Senegalese Roman Catholic who was appointed Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Saint-Louis du Sénégal in Senegal on 2 April 2025 by Pope Francis. He previously served a priest of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Dakar. He was consecrated and installed at Saint-Louis on 12 July 2025.
